title: Architectures and KV Replay for Depth-Recurrent Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.19446v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Depth recurrence increases effective model depth by repeatedly applying a fixed computation block. However, sharing attention parameters does not share the key-value (KV) states generated at different recurrence iterations, which causes memory growth with recurrence depth during autoregressive decoding. We study how to reduce this memory cost through architectural and cache-sharing approaches within a common depth-recurrent framework. We first study a looped hybrid that repeats a stack of Transformer layers, with recurrent mLSTM or Gated DeltaNet blocks replacing most attention layers and periodic Transformer attention anchors retained. We then restrict recurrence to a dedicated recurrent workspace in a Parcae-style architecture and test its stabilising adapter as a wrapper for the looped hybrid. Finally, we train a looped Transformer with recurrent KV replay, where only selected recurrence iterations write KV states that later iteration

translated_title: 深度循环语言模型的架构与KV重放方法
translated_abstract: 深度循环通过重复应用固定的计算块来增加模型的有效深度。然而，共享注意力参数并不会共享不同循环迭代中生成的键值（KV）状态，这导致自回归解码过程中内存随循环深度增长而增加。我们在一个统一的深度循环框架内，研究如何通过架构设计和缓存共享方法来降低这一内存开销。我们首先研究了一种循环混合架构，它重复堆叠Transformer层，用循环mLSTM或Gated DeltaNet块替代大部分注意力层，同时保留周期性的Transformer注意力锚点。随后，我们在Parcae风格架构中将循环限制在专用的循环工作区内，并测试其稳定化适配器作为循环混合架构的包装器。最后，我们训练了一个带循环KV重放机制的循环Transformer，其中只有选定的循环迭代会写入KV状态，供后续迭代重放使用（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文针对深度循环语言模型在自回归解码中KV缓存随循环深度增长的问题，提出了循环混合架构、Parcae风格专用循环工作区以及循环KV重放等架构与缓存共享方法来降低内存开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes architectural and cache-sharing approaches—including looped hybrid architectures, Parcae-style dedicated recurrent workspaces, and recurrent KV replay—to mitigate the KV memory growth caused by depth recurrence during autoregressive decoding of language models.
